title: Universe transport for Zariski restriction
statement: For every sheaf G of Type (u+1) on X, the ULift/order-isomorphism transport identifies the spectral closed restriction bijection with the Zariski inverse-image unit at the top open, yielding a bijection.

proof.text: Transport the spectral restriction bijection across the ULift homeomorphism and induced order isomorphisms of opens, preserving the sheaf adjunction unit at the top open.

mathlib_searches.query: transport sheaf restriction bijection along homeomorphism

lean.statement:
theorem zariski_restriction_universe_transport
    {X Z : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (hconn : ∀ x : X, IsConnected (closure ({x} : Set X) ∩ Set.range i)) :
      letI : ∀ P : X.Opensᵒᵖ ⥤ Type (u + 1),
          (Opens.map (i.base : Z.toTopCat ⟶ X.toTopCat)).op.HasPointwiseLeftKanExtension P :=
            fun P U ↦
              @Types.hasColimit.{u, u + 1, u}
                (CostructuredArrow.{u, u, u, u} (Opens.map i.base).op U)
                inferInstance (small_succ.{u} _) (CostructuredArrow.proj _ U ⋙ P)
      ∀ G : TopCat.Sheaf (Type (u + 1)) X.toTopCat,
      Function.Bijective
        (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
          (Opens.map (i.base : Z.toTopCat ⟶ X.toTopCat)) (Type (u + 1))
          (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (Opens.grothendieckTopology Z)).unit.app G).hom.app
            (op (⊤ : X.Opens)))
